ABOUT.TEXT: Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience, specialized in TypeScript (Angular, Vue) and .NET, working in an agentic way with AI every day. At {{age}}, I am currently a Senior Full-Stack Engineer at SQLI in Geneva, on assignment for SGS on a certification management platform: AI assistant integration, audit planning, .NET microservices and migration to Angular 19. Before that, I spent 6 years at SFEIR as Lead Full-stack on an industrial IoT platform for SIDEL, Lead Full-Stack Angular/Java for Stellantis, Lead Front-End Vue/Nuxt for PROXIMIS, and Engineering Manager of a team of 13 developers. My approach: AI proposes, the engineer validates — quality, tests and security first.
